summary: First research night for How Tech Works. Added 5 sourced Shorts topics (4 inventions, 1 machine), fixed 7 seed topics whose reference videos didn't beat their channel's audience, and put 2 title challengers on the list.
why: No videos yet, so the niche scan was the evidence: across 3,594 tech Shorts, titles saying 'you/your' get 0.81x their channel's median (20% hits) against 1.02x (31%), and invention titles get 2.29x. 7 of 18 seed topics cited references below their channel's subscribers, which check-plan rejects.

findings.title: 'You/your' titles do worse in tech Shorts
findings.detail: 0.81x vs 1.02x the channel median, 20% vs 31% hits (n=426); lower inside 19 of 29 channels. Three of our open titles say 'Your'.

findings.title: Invention Shorts are the niche's breakouts
findings.detail: Badream's typewriter 6.6M on 19.8K subscribers; Logibu's 'Most Important Invention, Part N' 5.35M and 3.96M on 36K.

findings.title: Zoom Shorts have no breakout reference
findings.detail: Their only Short references are Branch Education's, 0.2-0.4x of its 2.78M subscribers; re-referenced to Silicon Up Close (80.6x).

findings.title: The market scan doesn't cover this channel
findings.detail: market-data holds only Paisa Panchayat's finance scan; this channel's market.json has queries but no scan runs for it.

changes.title: 5 topics added
changes.detail: microwave, first transistor, first mobile phone, first digital camera, Hoover Dam; 3 high priority

changes.title: Seed topics fixed
changes.detail: 16 references given channel and subscribers, 5 re-referenced, zoom-sea-cable-slice rejected
